origin: ChatGPT premotor recruitment proposal with one native implementation choice by Codex; antecedent DNg100 not repeated
pulse_operation: Generic-rate CUDA consumer derives one fixed additional drive per source at its first coefficient evaluation at ON, using current incoming net, current drive and saved effective gain/theta. It then adds exactly that dose to the local drive term for [20,60)ms; no alteration of weights, gain, threshold, baseline or state q. Dose initialized in the initial coefficient evaluation before its dependent graph stages; read back and validated.

native_design_choices.A: Host pulse from last preceding coefficient: simpler but preceding stage is not exactly initial ON input; not chosen
native_design_choices.B: Pulse initialized inside actual native coefficient consumer at ON, fixed over pulse; chosen
native_design_choices.C: Fixed isolated-neuron target dose: useful historical probe but ignores recurrent current; not chosen

observation: 22 preselected ordinary-rate cells. q sampled each1ms; native last input/target plus maximum argument and positive-query count across ALL executed coefficient queries, including rejected trials. The latter is an upper bound on accepted sampled maxima; positive-query counts are not time occupancy. No claim of continuous physiology or exact accepted-time integrals.
readout: Original neural commands observed; identical archived body commands physically applied to all conditions. Tonic forward is allowed for this causal identification, not evidence of neural speed control.
inputs: Match final copied adapter drive/light/held_boundary_light/held_afferent_rate_hz at every125us boundary; pulse is internal to kernel and therefore separate from unchanged exogenous drive. Do not match endogenous PN general or recurrent states. Check body integration states, pending_sensors, FeCO and CxHP8 per1ms.

screen.classification: Descriptive recruitment screen, no physiological calibration or stage admission; no refined full200ms paired reference allocated
screen.subthreshold: Only if the maximum argument over ALL executed queries is <=0; positive maxima without endpoint q effect remain unresolved

stop: One bounded four-arm screen, stop at resource or interpretability failure. No retries with higher dose, changed window or threshold. A software fix may repeat only affected arms under a separately recorded correction.
